understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by moving the selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied by a selectable at the same time; when all goals are covered, the level reports WIN, and clearing all levels wins the run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you control one currently selected piece (shown as P in the semantic grid) and can move it one cell (3 pixels) in the four cardinal directions, subject to collisions. Walls (#) act as impassable obstacles that can block movement; blocks (B) can be pushable if directly adjacent in the direction of movement and if the space beyond them is free, causing both the selected piece and the block to shift. If movement is blocked (by a wall, boundary, or an unpushable/immovable object), the piece’s position does not change though the step is still consumed. Levels can include multiple selectables (S), and you can switch which one you control by using CLICK on that selectable’s exact pixel-coordinate position.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by moving the selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied by a selectable at the same time; when all goals are covered, the level reports WIN, and clearing all levels wins the run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you control one currently selected piece (shown as P in the semantic grid) and can move it one cell (3 pixels) in the four cardinal directions, subject to collisions. Walls (#) act as impassable obstacles that can block movement; blocks (B) can be pushable if directly adjacent in the direction of movement and if the space beyond them is free, causing both the selected piece and the block to shift. If movement is blocked (by a wall, boundary, or an unpushable/immovable object), the piece’s position does not change though the step is still consumed. Levels can include multiple selectables (S), and you can switch which one you control by using CLICK on that selectable’s exact pixel-coordinate position.
